title: Asian shares fall as US yields hit one-year high
title_zh: 美国国债收益率触及一年高位，亚洲股市下跌
summary: By Stella Qiu SYDNEY, May 15 (Reuters) - Asian shares came under pressure on Friday as investor euphoria over tech stocks gave way to inflation fears that saw Treasury yields spike to one-year highs
summary_zh: 路透悉尼 5 月 15 日 - 周五，亚洲股市承压，投资者对科技股的乐观情绪被通胀担忧所取代，美国国债收益率飙升至一年高点

title: Wall Street ends higher on tech rally; Cerebras soars in market debut
title_zh: 科技股上涨带动华尔街收高； Cerebras 上市首日飙升
summary: STORY: U.S. stocks rallied on Thursday, with the Dow and S&P 500 each gaining about three-quarters of a percent, and the Nasdaq climbing nearly nine-tenths of a percent.The Dow recaptured its position above the 50,000 mark, ending just shy of its all-time closing high.
summary_zh: 故事：美国股市周四上涨，道琼斯指数和标准普尔 500 指数均上涨约四分之三，纳斯达克指数上涨近十分之九。道琼斯指数重新站上 50,000 点大关，收盘略低于历史收盘高点。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures fall as Trump-Xi summit nears end
title_zh: 今日股市：随着特朗普与习近平峰会接近尾声，道指、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货下跌
summary: US stock futures were little changed after an upbeat day on Wall Street, as investors looked ahead to the final leg of President Trump's meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping.
summary_zh: 在华尔街乐观的一天之后，美国股指期货几乎没有变化，因为投资者展望特朗普总统与中国国家主席习近平会晤的最后阶段。

title: Tesla robotaxi rollout features long wait times, safety concerns
title_zh: 特斯拉机器人出租车的推出存在等待时间长、安全问题等问题
summary: STORY: Tesla's robotaxi service is experiencing significant operational problems in Texas, raising questions about CEO Elon Musk’s ambitious vision for a near future full of driverless cars.Reuters testing in Dallas, Houston and Austin found long wait times exceeding 30 minute...
summary_zh: 故事：特斯拉的机器人出租车服务在德克萨斯州遇到了严重的运营问题，这引发了人们对首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 在不久的将来充满无人驾驶汽车的雄心勃勃的愿景的质疑。路透社在达拉斯、休斯顿和奥斯汀进行的测试发现等待时间超过 30 分钟......

title: Musk vs. OpenAI lawyers' closing arguments hit on Musk's ambition, Altman's character
title_zh: 马斯克诉OpenAI律师结案陈词直击马斯克的野心、奥特曼的性格
summary: Lawyers for Musk and OpenAI sparred in closing arguments in the blockbuster trial.
summary_zh: 在这场轰动一时的审判中，马斯克和 OpenAI 的律师在结案陈词中发生了争执。

title: AI hyperscalers are 'falling behind' if they're not spending: Strategist
title_zh: 人工智能超大规模企业如果不花钱就会“落后”：策略师
summary: As AI chip stock rally and push the market (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) to new record highs, Hamilton Capital Partners CIO Alonso Munoz comes on Market Domination to speak more on the lofty capex spending these hyperscalers continue to invest into artificial intelligence.
summary_zh: 随着人工智能芯片股票上涨并推动市场（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）创下新高，Hamilton Capital Partners 首席信息官阿隆索·穆尼奥斯 (Alonso Munoz) 在《市场主导》节目中更多地谈论了这些超大规模企业继续投资于人工智能的高昂资本支出。

title: Dow back above 50,000, US stocks hit new records on AI rally
title_zh: 道指重回50000点上方，美股因AI涨势创新高
summary: US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) close Thursday's session higher after the Dow Jones Industrial Average crossed back above 50,000 points on the winds of the latest AI rally.
summary_zh: 美国股市 (^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC) 周四收盘走高，此前道琼斯工业平均指数在最新的人工智能反弹势头下重新站上 50,000 点上方。

title: What the Trump–Xi summit in China could mean for Nvidia
title_zh: 特朗普与习近平在中国举行的峰会对英伟达意味着什么
summary: President Trump's summit in China with President Xi is underway, with Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang and Tesla (TSLA) CEO Elon Musk tagging along. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley explains what talks in China could mean for Nvidia.
summary_zh: 特朗普总统与习近平主席在中国的峰会正在进行中，英伟达 (NVDA) 首席执行官黄仁勋和特斯拉 (TSLA) 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克也将随行。雅虎财经科技编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 解释了中国谈判对英伟达可能意味着什么。

title: Trump, Elon Musk are trying to open up China for business
title_zh: 特朗普和埃隆·马斯克正试图向中国开放商业
summary: President Trump's summit in China with President Xi is underway, with Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang and Tesla (TSLA) CEO Elon Musk tagging along. Yahoo Finance Washington Correspondent Ben Werschkul explains what you need to know from the first day of the summit.
summary_zh: 特朗普总统与习近平主席在中国的峰会正在进行中，英伟达 (NVDA) 首席执行官黄仁勋和特斯拉 (TSLA) 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克也将随行。雅虎财经华盛顿记者 Ben Werschkul 解释了峰会第一天您需要了解的内容。
